notes.title: Minor bug fixes and gameplay updates
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues:
[list]
[*] Adjusted the colliders for the whirlpool in the Moss Canyon level
[*] Moved around some mushrooms and mountains in the Observatory Scene
[/list]

Some gameplay updates:
[list]
[*] Added an intro cinematic for the game
[*] Added effects for the Boss Lady's attacks
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes and gameplay updates
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where quitting the game as a host causes the game to freeze
[*] Moved a floating rock in the Volcano level
[*] Fixed lights in the title screen
[*] Allow enemies to jump from high places so that they don't get stuck if they spawn there
[*] Enemies now avoid the lava
[*] Fixed a gap in the floor in a secret area in the Moss Canyon level
[/list]

Some gameplay updates:
[list]
[*] Updated the UI for when we have to find >3 keys
[*] Lit up the darker areas of the game with lanterns
[*] Moved the giant statue from Moss Canyon to Volcano level. Be careful of her
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes and gameplay updates
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where players would get damaged in quick succession by the eye guys
[/list]

Some gameplay updates:
[list]
[*] More keys now spawn when there are more players in the game
[*] Added some emergency 1 ups to the Volcano stage
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes and gameplay updates
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues:
[list]
[*] Removed some bright spots with the lighting
[*] Players can now no longer run through the fountain on the Volcano stage
[*] The whirlpool in the Moss Canyon no longer disappears when it is just barely on screen
[*] Players can now move when looking directly up or down
[*] Bunch of numbers in the game are now displayed with 2 decimal digits instead of whatever it was before (e.g. $12.50 instead of $12.50120210)
[*] Attempted to optimize the sounds a bit so that you can hear sweet rockets flying towards (or away from) you
[/list]

Some gameplay updates:
[list]
[*] Player income is now reduced in multiplayer games to counteract the fact that every kill by anyone gives everyone money
[*] Player rockets no longer hurt themselves
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes and gameplay updates
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues:
[list]
[*] Significantly improved the shadow quality in the game
[*] Fixed bug where players who joined the game late would experience the poverty bug (i.e. not receiving scaled income)
[*] Fixed bug in the Observatory level where birds were spawning in the mountain
[*] Pistol projectiles now spawn at the tip of the finger rather than right in the hand
[*] Fixed textures for some buildings
[*] Players should no longer experience permadeath if they're killed by lava
[/list]

Some gameplay updates:
[list]
[*] Added a crosshair to the game for those who wish to use it
[*] Full Heal stations are now Emergency 1 Up stations
[*] Number of keys scale with the number of players now
[*] Enemy HP now scales a little friendlier on each loop
[*] Income received reduced accordingly
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes and gameplay updates
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues:
[list]
[*] Fixed some missing colliders in the Volcano stage
[*] Improved performance further
[*] Fixed an issue where multiplayer clients were sometimes not getting extra gold from looping (the poverty bug)
[*] Fixed a bug where multiplayer clients' deaths were not being registered on the server, leading to a dead end state when all players are dead
[*] FPS players can now aim when they're dying (i.e. dead, but haven't become a ghost)
[*] Fixed a bug where exiting to the title screen would make music in the game get louder and louder
[/list]

Some gameplay updates:
[list]
[*] Changed the color of the ground for the levels so that bullets have more contrast
[*] Updated the grass texture in Moss Canyon
[*] Pistol (sniper? ) bullets are now the size of bowling balls and weigh about as much
[*] The rocket launcher rockets now travel much faster than before
[*] Changed the landscape of Moss Canyon a bit so that shadows fall more nicely on the walls
[*] Stormcrow rockets now have a bit of latency compensation so players with higher latency cannot cheese them as easily
[*] Added an options menu when in-game (accessed by hitting the Escape key on the keyboard)
[*] Weapon upgrades now no longer scale up the price of other weapon upgrades as much
[*] Reduced the amount of currency that looping players get
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes and gameplay updates
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues:
[list]
[*] Fixed loop level + next level animations
[/list]

Some gameplay updates:
[list]
[*] Lava now hurts the player. And everything that can get hurt. Lava hurts
[*] Rocket graphics have been improved
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes and gameplay updates
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues:
[list]
[*] Vignettes again? We finally found the main issue with why vignettes were coming on even when it was turned off in the options menu. This is hopefully the last we'll see of this problem
[/list]

Some gameplay updates:
[list]
[*] Added a third level! The third level is set near an active volcano. The lava will soon (but not yet) damage players and enemies alike
[*] Player's currently equipped weapons now stay the same across levels
[*] Stormcrow rockets now start slower but speed up geometrically. This means that they get faster, quicker
[*] Tweaked how movement speed upgrades and jump height upgrades stack. They now stack additively instead of multiplicatively
[*] Players now get more cash when enemies are killed on subsequent loops (scaling linearly with their HP boost)
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes and gameplay updates
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues:
[list]
[*] Player models no longer intersect with their hands when playing in FPS mode
[/list]

Some gameplay updates:
[list]
[*] Stormcrow rockets now get faster and faster as they remain in the world
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes and gameplay updates
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues:
[list]
[*] Patched up multiplayer netcode to handle some edge cases where players were going out of sync with each other
[/list]

Some gameplay updates:
[list]
[*] Added option for mouse look sensitivity
[*] Spaced out powerups in the staging area
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes and gameplay updates
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues:
[list]
[*] Hopefully finally fixed the issue where players are getting booted back to the staging area even when there are other players alive on the map
[*] Fixed a bug where some sounds were being played twice
[/list]

Some gameplay updates:
[list]
[*] The game can now be played as a regular FPS outside of VR!
[*] Player's wristwatch will now adjust itself so that the rocket launcher doesn't occlude it
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes and gameplay updates
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues:
[list]
[*] Fixed the lighting for the Moss Canyon and the Victory stage
[*] Fixed a bug where player data was not being successfully transferred in between stages (this usually happens when the stage changes before powerup data has finished transferring)
[*] Fixed the issue where you can kill your teammates with rockets
[/list]

Some gameplay updates:
[list]
[*] Improved the performance for the rocket launching birds
[*] Added sounds to rockets and the rocket bird (and their rockets)
[*] Added sounds to player rockets too
[*] Replaced the pistol into a sniper rifle
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes and gameplay updates
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues:
[list]
[*] Fixed a typo in the weapon damage up powerup text
[*] Fixed a bug where the movement vignette was showing up randomly even when it was disabled
[/list]

Some gameplay updates:
[list]
[*] For powerups that stack multiplicatively, the text now shows the factor (e.g. "x1.1") for clarity
[*] Looping levels now make the enemies much tougher than before
[*] Enlarged pistol & shotgun projectiles for clarity
[*] Added a new enemy. It flies, and launches homing rockets at you!
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where HP was shown as 1 after using up a life
[*] Wristwatch now shows objective when defending your coworker
[*] Fixed bug where players appear multiple times in the staging area when looping levels
[*] Updated text in Options to have higher contrast with the background
[*] Introduced a unique model for the "Exit to Title Screen" interactable
[/list]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed a few minor issues:
[list]
[*] Players can now navigate to the title screen after accepting an invite from another player
[*] Further optimized alien shot performance
[*] Simplified the textures in the staging area so that it looks more consistent with the rest of the game
